Alex Chen: Ok team — proposal to originate RC slate-2026-03-20 for the change window at 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC. Artifacts built from commit f2b9a3. Need quick heads-up: canaries, KV warm, and regression eval pass before prod promo.
Deploy Bot: rc created: rc-slate-2026-03-20 (id: rc-20260320-42). Artifact: s3://ci-artifacts/slate/rc-42.tar.gz. Staged namespace: staging-slate-42. To promote run: `deploybot promote --rc rc-20260320-42 --to prod --window 2026-03-22T02:00Z`
Maria Gomez: KV warm? we need warm on embed-service and kv-store prior to canary. I can trigger warmup 30m before window. :+1:
Simon Patel: Quick ask — regression eval results? AFAIK priya was running the large prompt suite. Any flakiness?
Priyanka Rao: Regression job finished on staging-slate-42. Summary: 412/420 checks passed. 8 failures: 5 small formatting diffs in reply templates, 3 timeouts in reranker under heavy load. Details in the eval report: https://ci/reports/rc-42/eval.
QA Bot: failing tests listed: `reply-format-typo-3`, `reply-format-spacing-7`, `reranker-timeout-102`, `reranker-timeout-103`, `reranker-timeout-208`, `edgecase-quote-12`, `edgecase-escape-4`, `email-template-missing-field`. All are flaky-level except `email-template-missing-field` which is a regression for transactional emails.
Alex Chen: Noted. The email-template miss is a blocker for prod. Can we patch-only the template? If small, prefer a cherry-pick and re-run eval. Otherwise plan fallback/pin.
Simon Patel: I can backport a fix for the template and run a targeted smoke. Patch PR ready: #3124 (cherry-pick onto rc-42). ETA ~40m.
Maria Gomez: Ok schedule hold for promo until patch/verify. I'll reserve the 02:00 window but mark promo as "conditional". Also setting canary ramp to 5% for first 15m.
Deploy Bot: Promo window reserved at 2026-03-22T02:00Z. Canary policy: 5% -> 25% after 15m -> 100% after 45m. Fallback: automatic rollback to pinned artifact if errors > 3% 5xx or latency p95 > 2s. Pin is optional — provide fallback id now if desired.
Alex Chen: Let's pin previous prod artifact as fallback: prod-artifact v1.14.3 (sha: 7a1f9c). Put that as fallback in deploy plan.
Priyanka Rao: I'll re-run the focused eval after the patch. Smoke checklist: `smoke-user-flow`, `email-send-check`, `rerank-mini-load`. I'll post results.
Eli Barnes: oncall acked. I'll monitor logs during promo and be ready to trigger rollback. @Alex @Maria tag me 5m before lift. :eyes:
Simon Patel: Patch merged to rc-42 and cherry-picked. Triggering targeted eval now. Command used: ```ci-run eval --suite email,reranker,smoke --target staging-slate-42 --tag rc-20260320-42-patch````
QA Bot: targeted eval complete: 420/420 checks passed. `email-template-missing-field` fixed. Reranker timeouts resolved under mini-load. Full eval not rerun but targeted looks green.
Alex Chen: Great. Given targeted pass and small patch, I'm OK to sign off for promo. Final checks: release notes entry, rollback playbook in the thread, and oncall confirmed.
Priyanka Rao: Release notes snippet: "Fix: transactional email template missing field (cherry-pick). Reranker load stabilization for long queries. Note: watch reranker p95 during first hour."
Maria Gomez: Ops checklist done: KV warm scheduled + cache priming at 2026-03-22T01:20Z, canary policy set, fallback pin to v1.14.3 configured.
Alex Chen: Rollback playbook (short): 1) `deploybot rollback --to-artifact 7a1f9c --rc rc-20260320-42` 2) Notify #incidents and oncall. 3) Open hotfix PR if needed. Keep rollback steps in ops runbook.
Deploy Bot: rc-20260320-42 promoted to staging (completed). Prod promotion pending final approve.
Eli Barnes: I'll be on watch. Pinged 5m before lift.
Alex Chen: Approving promotion to prod now. Promote command: `deploybot promote --rc rc-20260320-42 --to prod --window 2026-03-22T02:00Z --canary 5,25,100 --fallback 7a1f9c`
Deploy Bot: Starting promotion: canary 5% -> will report status. Logs: https://deploy/logs/rc-20260320-42.
Deploy Bot: Canary step completed (5%). No elevated errors in first 10min. Ramp to 25% in 2m.
Maria Gomez: Observing metrics: p95 OK, error rate ~0.12% under baseline. No alerts.
Deploy Bot: Ramp to 25% completed. Monitoring...
Deploy Bot: Ramp to 100% completed. Promotion to prod successful. Prod artifact: rc-20260320-42 deployed.
Alex Chen: :tada: Promo successful. Thanks everyone. Closing RC thread. I'll follow up with release note publication and customer-facing blurb.
Eli Barnes: oncall closing monitoring window; nothing to escalate. :thumbsup:
Priyanka Rao: I'll add the eval report to release notes and mark QA sign-off.
